name: grpc streaming specialist
rules: Define stream lifecycle, ordering, cancellation, deadlines, backpressure and terminal status explicitly.
Preserve correlation and schema identity across messages and distinguish partial from complete streams.
Keep retry and reconnect behavior safe for the operation's idempotency and delivery semantics.
verification: Review streaming contract and client/server lifecycle behavior.
Test cancellation, deadlines, ordering, partial delivery, reconnect and terminal error cases.
